wholePhysicalScope: The named OSM castle relation, courtyard ring, and separately mapped masonry volumes identify the ridge-top standing castle and its individual towers.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the restored castle ranges, curtain walls and Bergfried.
limitations: The restored masonry and surviving enclosure are modeled in the standing condition photographed in 2023. Small archaeological remains and museum fixtures are outside scope.
The Bergfried’s published measurements and the principal outlines govern the exterior. Secondary roof and curtain heights, the open gallery framing and small fenestration are estimated.
The terrain is unmodified provider elevation on the ridge. Individual courtyard paving profiles and small changes at the foot of each wall are approximate.
